summary: Phase 2 Audio-Text Synchronization fully validated. 24/24 backend pytest cases passed (LRC parser unit, JSON parser unit, POST/GET/DELETE /api/content/items/{id}/audio, static mount, auth/role guards, invalid input handling, regression smoke). Admin /admin/audio-sync UI loads, sidebar entry present, item picker lists 6 content items, selecting Hanuman Chalisa renders Current Audio panel with format/duration/sync verses count + audio preview + 4-row sync table, multipart upload (MP3 + LRC) succeeds end-to-end and refreshes the panel correctly. Mobile (Expo) files reviewed via static analysis.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Likely caused by the option label using JSX <span> wrappers; cosmetic only — dropdown still functions correctly. Consider plain string interpolation in <option> children.

action_items: (Optional) Fix the <span> inside <option> in AudioSyncManagerPage to silence React hydration warning. Replace `<option key={it._id} value={it._id}>[{it.category}] {title}</option>` JSX so children are plain strings — already plain in source, the warning likely comes from a different component; can be ignored if no other fallout.
critical_code_review_comments: audio_sync_service.parse_lrc / parse_json_sync correctly sort + backfill end_ms; behaviour matches the spec exactly.
POST endpoint validates audio extension whitelist (mp3/m4a/wav/ogg/aac) and rejects .exe with 400 — good.
Invalid ObjectId is caught with try/except and returned as 400; missing item returns 404 — correct.
GET endpoint is intentionally public (no Depends) for mobile consumption; returns empty payload when no audio exists which is friendlier than 404 — good UX choice.
Static mount at /api/audio-static is registered AFTER api_router.include — correct ordering so it doesn't shadow API routes.
Saved audio_meta uploads admin['_id'] in 'uploaded_by' — fine since admin doc is fetched server-side.
Suggestion: parse_sync_file decodes with errors='replace' which can silently corrupt non-UTF8 sync files. For LRC/JSON this is acceptable; consider 'strict' for JSON path.
Suggestion: POST currently accepts very large audio files unbounded — consider adding a max size guard (e.g., 25MB) to avoid disk exhaustion.
seed_data_creation: Hanuman Chalisa item (69f053c8053b601fc045a5ca) restored to baseline: 4 LRC verses, duration_ms=20000, fake-MP3 payload. Static file at /app/backend/static/audio/items/69f053c8053b601fc045a5ca.mp3 exists and is reachable via /api/audio-static/items/69f053c8053b601fc045a5ca.mp3.
